req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-031 requires GET /players/ to return all players sorted by insertion (id) order. The pre-loaded fixture has 26 rows with deterministic UUIDs. Tests must verify: (1) HTTP 200 status, (2) all 26 players returned, (3) ordering matches insertion/id order (first id = 5a9cd988..., last = da31293b...), (4) exact field values for boundary rows (first and last), (5) negative path for wrong HTTP method. Mutation-resilient assertions use exact counts, exact UUIDs, exact status codes, and exact ordering comparisons.

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_all_26_rows():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26

test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_all_26_rows()

preconditions: Database pre-loaded with 26 rows in known insertion order
actions: Compare id of first element vs last element to confirm ascending order
trace: R-PLAYER-031: insertion order means first inserted appears at index 0, not index 25
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_order_is_not_reversed():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert len(body) == 26
    first_id = body[0]['id']
    last_id = body[25]['id']
    assert first_id == '5a9cd988-95e6-54c1-bc34-9aa08acca8d0'
    assert last_id == 'da31293b-4c7e-5e0f-a168-469ee29ecbc4'
    assert first_id != last_id
    assert body[0]['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert body[25]['squadNumber'] == 26

test_get_all_players_order_is_not_reversed()

def test_get_all_players_consecutive_order_squad_10_and_11():
